description: This file implements cryptographic functions related to the 3GPP confidentiality and integrity algorithms, including multiplication with reduction, S-box transformations, LFSR and FSM clocking, keystream generation, and MAC computation, specifically for the SNOW 3G cipher used in mobile communications.

classes.name: S3G_STATE
classes.description: Structure representing the internal state of the SNOW 3G cipher, including LFSR and FSM components.

methods.name: s3g_mul_x
methods.description: Performs multiplication with reduction on an 8-bit value.

methods.name: s3g_mul_x_pow
methods.description: Performs recursive multiplication with reduction on an 8-bit value.

methods.name: s3g_mul_alpha
methods.description: Performs multiplication with alpha using a lookup table.

methods.name: s3g_div_alpha
methods.description: Performs division by alpha using a lookup table.

methods.name: s3g_s1
methods.description: Applies S-box S1 transformation on a 32-bit word.

methods.name: s3g_s2
methods.description: Applies S-box S2 transformation on a 32-bit word.

methods.name: s3g_clock_lfsr
methods.description: Advances the LFSR state based on the feedback function.

methods.name: s3g_clock_fsm
methods.description: Advances the FSM state and produces a 32-bit output.

methods.name: s3g_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SNOW 3G state with key and IV.

methods.name: s3g_deinitialize
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for the SNOW 3G state.

methods.name: s3g_generate_keystream
methods.description: Generates a keystream of specified length using the SNOW 3G cipher.

methods.name: s3g_f9
methods.description: Computes a 32-bit MAC using the UIA2 algorithm based on input data and parameters.
